intro: Football and traditional games are popular in Tuvalu, despite having little flat land.

chapters.title: Sport
text: Kilikiti, a Polynesian form of cricket, and te ano, a ball game, are traditional.

chapters.title: Olympics
text: Tuvalu has sent sprinters and weightlifters to every Summer Olympics since 2008.

places.title: Famous venues
places.intro: Where Tuvalu's biggest sporting moments happen.
